parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer that fits into the table frame, typically rectangular in shape.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing small items such as stationery or personal belongings.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails or grooves within the table frame.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the left side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table body.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel forming the right side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides structural support and stability to the table body.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A tapered wooden leg supporting the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the table and maintains balance.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Front)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the front legs of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral stability and prevents wobbling.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Back)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the back legs of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides lateral stability and prevents wobbling.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden panel located at the back of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: Provides enclosure and additional structural rigidity.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the left legs of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides side stability and prevents lateral movement.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the right legs of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides side stability and prevents lateral movement.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a surface for placing objects, writing, or working.
